[[File:Toomas Trapido.jpg|thumb|Toomas Trapido]]

'''Toomas Trapido''' (born 15 April 1972) is an [[Estonians|Estonian]] biologist, researcher, educator, and politician. He was a member of the [[XI Riigikogu]].<ref name="riigikogu.ee">{{cite web |title=Juhatus ja liikmed |url=https://www.riigikogu.ee/tutvustus-ja-ajalugu/riigikogu-ajalugu/xi-riigikogu-koosseis/juhatus-ja-liikmed/ |website=Riigikogu |access-date=16 February 2021 |language=et}}</ref>

Trapido was born in [[Tallinn]]. He is a member of the [[Estonian Greens]] party.<ref name="riigikogu.ee" />
